spacesButton.qualification: In a space, the resting Island shows no Space mark; the command panel's footer Spaces button (overlay.html #footerWorkspace) draws the current space's tile, its symbol on its color, in place of the planet, with the space's name in its tooltip (workspace-ui.js syncIdentity, ws.trigger.current). Clicking it opens the Spaces menu to switch, edit, reorder or delete a space, with Undo. Verified at v1.49.0 (overlay.html #footerWorkspace; workspace-ui.js syncIdentity; renderer.js hides #pillSpace on the horizontal Island, spaceMarkOnIsland; en.json ws.trigger.current "Space · {name}") and unchanged at v1.51.0. With vertical tabs the side list still shows the mark at its top, which the claim doesn't contradict.
